from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/analytics/sandbox")

class SandboxQueryRequest(BaseModel):
    session_id: str
    query_script: str

@router.post("/run-query")
async def run_sandbox_analytics_query(
    req: SandboxQueryRequest,
    sandbox_pool: PyodideSessionPool = Depends(get_pyodide_session_pool),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    session_instance = sandbox_pool.get_session(req.session_id)
    if not session_instance:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Active Pyodide analytics session not found")

    # Vulnerable: Executes script in the in-memory SQLite sandbox without verifying tenant ownership
    results = session_instance.eval_sqlite_script(req.query_script)
    return {"session_id": req.session_id, "results": results}
diagnosis: The Pyodide analytics sandbox route runs SQL scripts against an active in-memory SQLite instance registered in session_instance by session_id. It authenticates current_user but never checks if session_instance.tenant_id matches current_user.tenant_id, allowing cross-tenant extraction of confidential in-memory database rows.
